response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_fill_size FROM per_order), first_group AS (SELECT p.avg_fill_size, p.avg_fill_size - b.avg_fill_size AS first_margin FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.avg_fill_size), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_fill_size FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(g.avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size, AVG(g.first_margin) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark, AVG(g.avg_fill_size - b.avg_fill_size) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark FROM first_group g CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE g.avg_fill_size > b.avg_fill_size;
